title.zh: 将萨马省 Guiuan市镇南部萨马国立 High 工艺学校的名称变更为南部萨马国立区域工艺学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Southern Samar National High School of Arts and Trades in the Municipality of Guiuan, Province of Samar, to Southern Samar National Regional School of Arts and Trades
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Southern Samar National High School of Arts and Trades in the Municipality of Guiuan, Province of Samar, to Southern Samar National Regional School of Arts and Trades
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Southern Samar National High School of Arts and Trades tại Thị trấn Guiuan, Tỉnh Samar thành Southern Samar National Regional School of Arts and Trades
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Southern Samar National High School of Arts and Trades ในเทศบาล Guiuan, จังหวัด Samar เป็น Southern Samar National Regional School of Arts and Trades
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Southern Samar National High School of Arts and Trades di Kotamadya Guiuan, Provinsi Samar menjadi Southern Samar National Regional School of Arts and Trades
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Southern Samar National High School of Arts and Trades di Perbandaran Guiuan, Wilayah Samar menjadi Southern Samar National Regional School of Arts and Trades

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_3859_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Southern Samar National School of Arts and Trades in the Municipality of Guiuan, Province of Samar, is hereby changed to Southern Samar National Regional School of Arts and Trades.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 12, 1964.
